storage_model.placement_scope: HBM residence or HBF backing with bounded HBM staging; no direct compute on HBF
storage_model.kv_offload_timing: QKV projection, block append/read stream, then aggregate attention and remaining GEMM; no stream/compute overlap
storage_model.kv_hotness: recent token blocks per request and layer; soft eviction preference
storage_model.hbf_log: shared append-only physical backing; old versions are not garbage collected in this run
storage_model.capacity_scope: HBM maxima use conservative per-stage/lane bounds; KV cache and weight cache are separate reservations
storage_model.legacy_metrics: top-level hbf_fill/writeback fields refer to weights; storage_metrics.kv and hbf_log report KV transfers

model_accounting.capacity_scope: HBM feasibility covers modeled block weights, KV and scratch; not the full checkpoint
model_accounting.parallelism_assumption: ideal TP sharding of weights and KV; framework-specific KV-head replication is not modeled

critical_path.scope: operation dependencies; HBM internal scheduling is an opaque timed span

bottleneck.interpretation: time attribution, not a counterfactual speedup prediction
